mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rates above 4.5% triggers expectations of weak labor demand, reducing corporate earnings growth and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or t-test p >0.05 showing no significant negative relationship.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rates and robust demand growth (GDPC1) create a dual expansion signal, amplifying equity valuation through lower discount rates and stronger earnings expectations, driving positive 60-day forward returns.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with strong demand
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p >0.05) when both proxies are favorable, or interaction effect rank IC <0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid expansion in supply (INDPRO >110) coupled with low inflation (CPIAUCSL <105) signals a balanced supply-demand environment, reducing growth risks and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when trigger met, or IC <0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in housing demand indicators (HOUST <1500) signals weakening consumer spending, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when trigger occurs, or IC >0.03 over 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low unemployment (UNRATE <4%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS >137258) indicate a robust labor market, fostering economic expansion and positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both proxies are high, or IC <0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 5% coupled with rising CPIAUCSL signals aggressive monetary tightening and inflationary pressures, compressing equity valuations and driving negative 60-day returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS >5% and CPIAUCSL rising >2% over 3 months
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with inflationary risks
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) when trigger met, or IC >0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (GDPC1 >11541) alongside robust supply expansion (INDPRO >111.9282) reduces inflationary pressures and supports equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both proxies are high, or IC <0.03 over 2-year window.
